title: Battle of Cagayan de Misamis
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Cagayan de Misamis", at revision 1373821961, opens: "The Battle of Cagayan de Misamis was fought on April 7, 1900, in the town of Cagayan de Misamis in Mindanao, Philippines, during the Philippine–American War. The Filipinos were under the command of General Nicolas Capistrano." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870605, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1900 battle of the Philippine–American War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
